articles.title: US, Japan Agree To Establish Missile Production Facility Under 'Operation Supercharge'
articles.summary: The United States and Japan have reportedly agreed to establish a facility in Japan for the final assembly and check-out of advanced medium-range air-to-air missiles (AMRAAMs). This strategic move aims to enhance regional security, strengthen the US-Japan alliance, and improve interoperability between their forces, potentially streamlining missile delivery and maintenance for Indo-Pacific stability.

articles.title: The quiet part Out Loud: Mia Freedman's call to arms for Australian media
articles.summary: The latest Mumbrellacast featured Mamamia co-founder Mia Freedman's speech at her company's upfront. Freedman urged advertisers to halt specific practices. While the precise details of her appeal to 'stop pump...' are unstated due to the truncated text, this signals ongoing industry discussions and ethical considerations within the national media and advertising sector.
